language_task: stack the yellow block on the blue blocks
outcome_evidence: In right_shoulder_cam, the robot approaches and acquires the yellow block in frames 6–22, then transports it toward the two blue blocks in frames 23–30. Frames 31–34 show the yellow block lowered onto or immediately above the blue blocks, but the gripper remains around it; release and independent support are not visibly confirmed. Completion is therefore unconfirmed at the recording end, rather than a visibly failed stacking attempt.
